verdict.rationale: No evidence item states that the Outlook/Graph mail APIs are versioned or that Microsoft publishes a deprecation policy. The only hint of versioning is the 'view=graph-rest-1.0' parameter in some doc URLs, which is not an affirmative documented claim. Nothing in the pack addresses deprecation timelines or policy at all.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
